get_user_manual.description: Read this co-worker's installed user manual without starting work.

get_capabilities.description: Discover the supervision profile, declared tools, schemas, and current availability.

get_job_profile.description: Read identity, mission, safe configuration, schedule, and lifecycle state.

get_job_context.description: Read bounded Job context, recent runs, and published evidence.

get_run_status.description: Read a run's actual runtime state; omit run_id to select the latest run.

get_run_results.description: Read bounded published results and artifact references for a run.

watch_job_activity.description: Wait at most 25 seconds for one new Job activity; never acknowledge a human notice.

get_operation_status.description: Read the observed status of an operation belonging to this Job.

start_run.description: Explicitly start a new run using the saved validated Job configuration.

pause_run.description: Pause the specified active run while preserving the ability to resume it.

stop_run.description: Terminate the specified run by cancellation; this is different from pausing.

send_mailbox_message.description: Queue a message from this Job to a configured peer, including a stopped peer.

list_mailbox_messages.description: Read this Job's inbox in sequence order without consuming messages.

acknowledge_mailbox_message.description: Mark a received message as handled. This never grants approval.

conversations.name: ask_job
conversations.description: Ask a fast, grounded, multi-turn question about this job's purpose, status, progress, published results, or missing evidence. This never starts a Run.

AssistanceTask.description: Desktop-owned intent; operational facts and authorization stay runtime-owned.
AssistanceTask.title: AssistanceTask

conversations.name: ask_job
conversations.description: Ask the bounded Job agent a grounded question or an explicit simulation command. This never starts or resumes a Run.

conversations.name: get_job_turn
conversations.description: Poll one accepted bounded-agent turn until its observed operation reaches a terminal state.
